articles.summary: Green Canopy NODE was featured in a Green Building Advisor article highlighting our innovative approach to prefabrication. The article highlights our Utility Kit system , which integrates mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems for offsite construction, helping streamline installation.
articles.title: Featured in Green Building Advisor: Next-Generation Prefabrication
